name: Roasted Spaghetti Squash with Pork Sausage Ragù & Parmesan
instructions: Preheat oven to 500°F and place rack in the center position. Line a large baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry each squash; trim, halve lengthwise, and scrape out the seeds. Rub the inside of the squash with oil and season with salt and pepper. Arrange halves, cut-side down, on the baking sheet.
Place squash in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender, so a knife can easily pierce through the flesh, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim, and small dice celery.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add celery, onion, and sausage; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, about 5 minutes.
Add marinara, water, salt, and pepper to the pot; stir to combine the ragù. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
When the squash is done, remove from oven and allow to cool slightly, about 5 minutes.
Scrape the inside of the squash with a fork to separate into spaghetti-like strands. (Use an oven mitt or towel to hold it with your other hand.)
To serve, divide squash and ragù between plates or bowls. Top with Parmesan and enjoy!
author: Mealime
